title: Culmina — independent source audit of design-rule adherence
head: 0e2130238f6d241cec270f65ff030d2ea67cf73f
mode: Read-only production source audit by delegated agent
verdict: Substantial source-backed adoption with two confirmed local discrepancies and two implementation risks requiring current visual/runtime validation. No whole-app compliance score is warranted.

findings.title: Custom switches bypass reduced-motion handling

rule.excerpt: - Use AppMotion and its reduced-motion handling. Source-owned scientific sky ramps and stacking-gain gradients are functional data presentation, not permission to add decorative effects.

findings.impact: HybridSwitch always configures a 120 ms alignment animation, including when the device requests disabled animations. This is an actual production dependency chain, not an unused gallery component.
findings.minimalSuggestion: Use AppMotion.duration(context, AppMotion.short) for this animation and the existing motion curve; verify the disabled-animation branch.
findings.risk: Low; switch state, semantics, hit target and persistence must remain unchanged.
findings.acceptance: A value change with disableAnimations=true has zero configured animation duration; normal mode uses the adopted short duration. This audit did not execute a runtime toggle.

findings.title: Total session time caption unconditionally promises setup and calibration

rule.excerpt: - Preserve Capture Plan assumptions, calibration policies, exposure/filter groups and fit reasons. Follow actual camera-class validation rather than hiding inconvenient inputs.

findings.impact: The displayed caption implies setup is included even when the detail explicitly says Not included. This is a wording/assumption mismatch, not evidence that the numeric calculator is wrong.
findings.minimalSuggestion: Derive the local caption from included budget components; explicitly disclose omitted setup and preserve null versus configured zero.
findings.risk: Low; avoid changing calculations or conflating in-window time with total session budget.
findings.acceptance: No-setup, zero-setup and positive-setup states have captions consistent with expanded facts; calibration placement meanings and all durations remain unchanged.

findings.title: App-bar title height depends on an estimated action width

rule.excerpt: - Diagnose available width, wrapping and padding before shrinking text. Preserve the user's text scaler and full accessible labels. Compact chart/calendar/navigation roles are explicit exceptions in current source, not a global size prescription.

findings.impact: The height measurement assumes 48 pixels for each action and does not subtract the separately configured actionsPadding. Actual title layout can have a narrower constraint, especially with long identity strings and large text. Source inspection alone does not establish visible clipping.
findings.minimalSuggestion: Compare the measured width with actual toolbar title constraints for the saved-entry caller before choosing a bounded correction; retain the text scaler and full accessible title.
findings.risk: Medium if changing the shared helper, because many screens adopt it.
findings.acceptance: Render long entry names at 375/412 widths and 100/150/200% in all themes; inspect title pixels and control reachability, not just absence of exceptions.

findings.title: Field tracking guidance uses the dim secondary status role

rule.excerpt: 4. Inspect affected foreground/background pairs in Light, Dark and Field Red. Keep red/black field presentation and the production filter in `lib/main.dart`; evaluate accessibility against actual rendered uses rather than assuming all themes meet a threshold.

findings.impact: Unknown tracking guidance resolves to #AA0000 against field grouping surfaces defined as #110000. This source pairing merits a rendered readability check, but code colors alone are not visual accessibility acceptance or a physical low-light finding.
findings.minimalSuggestion: Inspect the current warning and corrective-action render; if readability is insufficient, use an existing higher-contrast role locally without turning an unknown condition into a confirmed failure.
findings.risk: Medium: field brightness/comfort and semantics need owner/device review.
findings.acceptance: Verify actual rendered pairings, conditional wording, red-only output and readability on a physical low-light device.

scope: All five active Culmina design skills
Current production theme, motion, app-bar, Plan, Tonight, Settings, time and persistence callers
checksPerformed: Read active guidance rather than treating compatibility pointers as independent rules
Traced HybridSwitch through HybridSwitchRow into production Settings
Compared unconditional time caption with optional setup detail and owning domain formula
Inspected app-bar measurement and saved-entry adopter
Inspected source Field foreground/surface definitions and the tracking warning adopter
Inspected no-site, UTC/night, plan-state and leaving-guard implementation
Searched presentation code for scaler clamps, custom font families, raw colors and animation durations; matches were leads, not automatically violations
limitations: No production changes or dependency changes were made.
No new renders, Android interactions, TalkBack sessions, physical low-light checks or runtime switch toggles were performed by this subagent.
This is representative code inspection, not proof that every screen/state follows every rule.
Existing earlier visual findings were not used as proof for the source-only risk classifications.
Hardcoded spacing/radii matching existing local compositions were not treated as violations merely because they were literals.
A source role declaration or test file presence is not a runtime or owner-acceptance pass.
